description: Fix the Performance Regression workflow, Quality Gate workflow, and ensure Cloudflare Pages build can succeed by adding VITE_BACKEND_URL env var where frontend builds happen, and adding MongoDB service to the quality gate backend job
steps: In .github/workflows/agent-performance-regression.yml: Add an env block to the 'Build frontend' step (or job-level env) with VITE_BACKEND_URL: https://api.syrabit.ai. This is needed because the build script (scripts/build.mjs) calls check-build-env.mjs which hard-fails without VITE_BACKEND_URL.
In .github/workflows/agent-quality-gate.yml: Add an env block to the frontend-quality job's 'Build frontend' step with VITE_BACKEND_URL: https://api.syrabit.ai for the same reason.

In .github/workflows/agent-quality-gate.yml: The backend-quality job runs pytest which needs MongoDB. Add a services section with a MongoDB container (similar to ci-backend.yml which has: services: mongodb: image: mongo:7, env: MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_USERNAME: test, MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_PASSWORD: test, ports: - 27017:27017). Also add MONGODB_URI, APP_ENV, and JWT_SECRET environment variables to the pytest step (MONGODB_URI: mongodb://test:test@localhost:27017, APP_ENV: test, JWT_SECRET: test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long).

In .github/workflows/agent-performance-regression.yml: Also add VITE_BACKEND_URL to the 'Install dependencies' step environment (or set it at job level) to ensure the entire build pipeline has the variable available.
Verify that the agent-security-scan.yml gitleaks step uses --source . which will benefit from .gitleaks.toml (done in FEAT-001).
acceptance_criteria: agent-performance-regression.yml has VITE_BACKEND_URL set for the frontend build step
agent-quality-gate.yml frontend-quality job has VITE_BACKEND_URL set for the build step
agent-quality-gate.yml backend-quality job has a MongoDB service container and the pytest step has MONGODB_URI, APP_ENV, JWT_SECRET environment variables
All workflow YAML files are syntactically valid
verification: Grep for VITE_BACKEND_URL in both workflow files to confirm it is present
